scope: Baseline lifecycle capabilities; API spelling and on-disk compatibility are not required.

mapping.airbug: --save-baseline NAME creates; --replace-baseline NAME upserts measured cases. Combine --baseline-lenient NAME --replace-baseline NAME to compare to the named baseline and then update it.
mapping.evidence: test-cargo-bench.py: named baseline save, comparison before replacement, partial update and workload/output failures

mapping.feature: Retain existing baseline for strict/lenient comparison
mapping.airbug: --baseline NAME and --baseline-lenient NAME leave all references unchanged. Criterion retain_baseline maps to these comparison flags, not to Airbug --retain-baseline (an additional fill-missing-cases operation).
mapping.evidence: test-cargo-bench.py: missing selected case before setup, missing name, unchanged pointer and corruption rejection

mapping.feature: Load saved samples instead of measuring
mapping.airbug: --load-baseline NAME, optionally --baseline OTHER; preserves observed values and source metadata; reanalyzes each source independently.
mapping.evidence: test-cargo-bench.py: setup/workload guards, equal original observations, mixed-source export; baseline::tests::reanalysis_groups_by_artifact_and_preserves_identity_collisions

mapping.airbug: --discard suppresses artifact/history/dashboard writes while measurements and console summaries run.
mapping.evidence: test-cargo-bench.py: empty output root with both histories enabled; preflight rejects persistence conflicts

mapping.airbug: Atomic case manifests preserve unselected references, run identity and environment; concurrent updates use OS locks.
mapping.evidence: baseline::tests::case_updates_preserve_other_runs_provenance_and_concurrent_changes; test-cargo-bench.py: save two, replace one, reload both

mapping.airbug: Hash-checked snapshots; explicit replacement can repair selected sources; retained corrupt sources prevent publication.
report aliases compare stable case IDs; baseline save updates existing case manifests; retention protects sources and shares publication lock. Legacy whole-run references remain supported.

limitations: Single-run runner operations do not pool multi-source baselines; use report or direct load-baseline for those.
Statistics, report formatting and platform support have separate parity requirements.
Snapshots may remain unreferenced if publication fails; no old artifact is overwritten.

cli_validation_followup.result: 263 combined option checks, 7 baseline library tests and 3 profiling integration tests passed on macOS ARM64; all-target/all-feature Clippy passed
cli_validation_followup.name_policy: Nonempty ASCII letters/digits/hyphen/underscore. Native identifiers, not upstream arbitrary path/name compatibility. Same pure validator used by Store paths and direct harness before preview/list/execution.
cli_validation_followup.fix: Previously --dry-run accepted invalid baseline names that ordinary execution rejected later. Empty, traversal/separator, dotted, spaced and non-ASCII names now fail preview without storage access.
cli_validation_followup.storage_laziness: Valid names can be previewed against nonexistent storage without creating it. Ordinary strict comparison/load of missing names fails before workload or history writes. Existence/integrity checks remain part of normal execution, not lazy preview.
cli_validation_followup.profiling: Preview accepts positive decimal millisecond durations including 1 ns; zero, negative, nonfinite and host-clock-unrepresentable Duration::MAX fail. Conflicts with test, explicit bootstrap, adaptive quick, overhead subtraction, throughput formatting, save/load/compare baseline and discard all reject before execution. Existing integration tests verify actual timing and profiler lifecycle.
cli_validation_followup.limits: Filesystem path-length/permission behavior is host dependent. Windows runtime and full public-API configuration review remain separate.

source_semantic_followup.verified: Save replaces baseline after comparison; strict comparison checks baseline existence before sampling; loading saved samples bypasses measurement. Retained comparison leaves the baseline unchanged while results may still be saved separately.
native_differences: Airbug validates all selected strict references before any workload, uses immutable sources and atomically publishes a case manifest.
Airbug --save-baseline is create-only; --replace-baseline supplies upstream overwrite capability; comparison and replacement are explicit independent flags.
Airbug retain operation fills missing cases and is distinct from Criterion retain_baseline. Names use a restricted native identifier domain.
source_semantic_followup.validation: All seven baseline library tests passed with --offline --locked --all-features on macOS; recent test-relative-cargo.py passed actual saved-baseline lazy reanalysis and comparison output.
